Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue USD 2,581,000; operating result USD -4,653,000; net result USD -8,260,000; total assets USD 304,044,000; equity USD 217,323,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue USD 239,597,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Engebret Dahm; board chair Ernst André Meyer; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.klaveness.com.
